BiblicalUsage: Senaah was a place whose children returned from exile in large numbers, three thousand six hundred and thirty in Ezra's list, and whose sons built the fish gate in Jerusalem's wall. A town that came home and got to work.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts the returning exiles town by town, and Senaah shows a whole community coming back to build.
